MeetingTitle: Faculty of Psychiatry GCPS & Dalhousie University Dept of Psychiatry Collaboration Meeting
AttendeesPresent: Prof. Vincent Agyapong (Dalhousie University); Dr. Kofi Mensah (GCPS); Dr. Abena Sarfo (GCPS); Dr. Yaw Boateng (GCPS)
AttendeesAbsent: Dr. Grace Asante (apologies); Dr. Kwesi Annan (apologies)
Agenda: 1. Welcome and opening remarks; 2. Review of previous action items; 3. Fellowship curriculum updates; 4. Research collaboration opportunities; 5. Faculty exchange programme; 6. Any other business; 7. Date of next meeting
Proceedings: 1. Welcome and opening remarks — The Chair welcomed all members and thanked them for attending. A quorum was confirmed.; 2. Review of previous action items — All items from the previous meeting have been addressed. The revised curriculum document has been circulated.; 3. Fellowship curriculum updates — Dr. Mensah presented the updated rotation schedule. It was agreed that forensic psychiatry rotations would be extended to 3 months. The committee approved the changes unanimously.; 4. Research collaboration opportunities — Prof. Agyapong proposed joint research grants between Dalhousie and Ghanaian institutions. The faculty agreed to develop a proposal by September 2026.; 5. Faculty exchange programme — A faculty exchange programme was discussed with Dalhousie faculty visiting Ghana for short-term teaching blocks. Dates to be confirmed.; 6. Any other business — The need for additional supervisors at KATH was raised. Prof. Agyapong offered to facilitate additional supervisor training.; 7. Date of next meeting — The next meeting is scheduled for 4 August 2026 at 10:00 AM via virtual platform.
ActionItems: 1. Dr. Mensah to finalise the extended forensic psychiatry rotation schedule by 21 July 2026.; 2. Prof. Agyapong to share joint research grant templates with the Faculty.; 3. Faculty exchange programme — Dr. Sarfo to coordinate dates with Dalhousie administration.; 4. All supervisors to complete updated log-book sign-off by 31 July 2026.; 5. Dr. Boateng to circulate revised fellowship handbook by 14 July 2026.
AdjournmentNotes: The Chair thanked all participants for their contributions. The meeting was adjourned at 12:30 PM.
